question: The lengths of the three sides of a right-angled triangle are (x - 1) cm, (x + 1) cm and (x + 3) cm, respectively. The hypotenuse of the right-angled triangle (in cm) is:
solution:
**Given:**

The lengths of the three sides of a right-angled triangle are (x - 1) cm, (x + 1) cm and (x + 3) cm

**Formula used:**

In a right-angled triangle,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e8a276c5607a5e51b77f19a997e9430c5ce95d62d9f8f978dd239e09376fa32.png] 

Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + Base²

**Calculation:**

Here, (x + 3) is greater than other sides for each value of x

We can take (x + 3) as the hypotenuse
